title: Implement User Authentication and Role-Based Access Control
description: Set up Better Auth authentication system with PostgreSQL database using Drizzle ORM, implementing secure user registration, login, and role-based access control for Managers, Respondents, Executives, and Admins.
details: Create user authentication schema with Drizzle ORM including users table with role field. Implement Better Auth configuration with email/password authentication. Create middleware for route protection based on user roles. Set up database migrations for user and role tables. Implement sign-up and sign-in forms using shadcn/ui components. Create role-based dashboard routing that redirects users to appropriate interfaces based on their role. Ensure proper TypeScript typing for user sessions and role checking throughout the application.
test_strategy: Unit tests for authentication functions, role validation middleware, and database operations. Integration tests for complete auth flow from registration to role-based dashboard access. E2E tests using Playwright for user registration, login, and role-based navigation flows.
ai_result: Successfully implemented user authentication system with Better Auth and PostgreSQL using Drizzle ORM. Created role-based access control system with support for Admin, Manager, Executive, and Respondent roles. Added role field to user schema, implemented middleware for route protection, created role-specific dashboard pages, and set up proper TypeScript types. The system includes secure user registration/login flows, middleware-based route protection, role-based UI components, API endpoints for user management, and comprehensive type safety throughout the application.

title: Apply Custom Tangerine Theme Variables
description: Integrate the tangerine theme from the provided URL into the application's global styling system, updating both CSS variables and Tailwind configuration to support light/dark mode theming across all components.
details: Fetch the theme configuration from https://tweakcn.com/r/themes/tangerine.json and extract the CSS variables for both :root and .dark selectors. Update app/globals.css with these variables, ensuring proper color definitions for primary, secondary, background, foreground, and chart colors (--chart-1 through --chart-5). Modify tailwind.config.js to reference these CSS variables in the theme.extend.colors section, using the format 'var(--primary)' for each color. Verify that the dark mode strategy is set to 'class' in the Tailwind config. Test that existing shadcn/ui components automatically pick up the new theme colors and that chart components use the new --chart-* variables.
test_strategy: Perform visual regression testing across key components in both light and dark modes. Test the theme toggle functionality to ensure smooth transitions. Verify that chart components correctly inherit the new color variables. Create component tests to ensure shadcn/ui components render with the expected theme colors.
ai_result: Applied Tangerine theme variables to globals.css and updated tailwind.config.js to reference CSS variables directly with class-based dark mode

title: Build Content Management System for Quiz Creation
description: Develop the core content creation interface allowing Managers to create quizzes, trivias, and surveys with questions, options, and basic configuration settings.
details: Create database schema for content types (quiz, trivia, survey) and questions using Drizzle ORM. Build content creation forms with shadcn/ui components including title, description, and question builder interface. Implement dynamic question addition/removal with support for single-choice and multiple-choice questions. Create content type selection interface and question management components. Add form validation using TypeScript and Zod schemas. Implement auto-save functionality for draft content. Create API routes for content CRUD operations with proper role-based authorization.
test_strategy: Unit tests for content creation forms, validation schemas, and API endpoints. Integration tests for database operations and content persistence. E2E tests for complete content creation workflow including adding/removing questions and saving drafts.

title: Create AI Chat API Endpoint with Context Integration
description: Develop a serverless API route that accepts user queries, fetches relevant context from existing APIs, and integrates with OpenAI to provide intelligent responses about quiz performance and organizational insights.
details: Create app/api/ai/chat/route.ts with a POST handler that accepts { userId, role, query } payload. Implement data fetching from existing /api/questions and /api/performance endpoints to gather contextual information. Install and configure the OpenAI client library, ensuring the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable is properly configured. Design a comprehensive prompt template that combines the user's query with the fetched performance data and question analytics. Implement proper error handling for API failures, timeout scenarios, and OpenAI rate limits. Add request validation using TypeScript interfaces and ensure responses are returned within the 3-second requirement. Include proper logging for debugging and monitoring purposes.
test_strategy: Unit test the API route with mocked internal API calls and OpenAI responses. Test error scenarios including network failures, invalid payloads, and API timeouts. Create integration tests that verify the complete flow from request to response. Mock the OpenAI API to test various response scenarios and ensure proper error handling.
ai_result: Created AI Chat API endpoint with OpenAI integration, contextual data fetching from /api/questions and /api/performance, proper error handling, and 3-second timeout protection

title: Implement Draft Management and Content Scheduling
description: Add functionality for saving content as drafts and scheduling automatic publication with deadline and time limit configuration.
details: Extend content schema to include draft status, scheduled publication date, deadline, and time limit fields. Create draft management interface showing saved drafts with edit and publish options. Implement scheduling system with date/time picker using shadcn/ui calendar components. Add deadline and time limit configuration forms with validation. Create background job system or cron-like functionality for automatic content publication. Implement content status tracking (draft, scheduled, published, expired). Add manager dashboard view for content overview with status indicators.
test_strategy: Unit tests for scheduling logic, draft state management, and date/time validation. Integration tests for automatic publication system and content status transitions. E2E tests for complete draft-to-publication workflow including scheduling and deadline setting.

title: Build AI Chat UI Component and Page
description: Create a responsive chat interface component and corresponding page that allows Managers and Executives to interact with the AI system, featuring real-time messaging, loading states, and error handling.
details: Develop components/AIChat.tsx as a reusable chat component using shadcn/ui components for consistent styling. Implement a message history display, input field with send button, and proper loading indicators during API calls. Add state management for chat history, loading states, and error conditions. Create app/dashboard/(manager)/ai-chat/page.tsx to host the chat component with proper page layout and metadata. Implement real-time typing indicators and message timestamps. Add proper error boundaries and user-friendly error messages when API calls fail. Ensure the component is fully responsive and accessible, meeting WCAG 2.1 AA standards. Include auto-scroll functionality for new messages and proper keyboard navigation support.
test_strategy: Create component tests for the AIChat component covering different states (loading, error, success). Test user interactions like sending messages, handling errors, and displaying responses. Implement E2E tests for the complete chat flow from the page level. Test responsive behavior across different screen sizes and ensure accessibility compliance.

title: Develop CSV Bulk Upload and Content Assignment System
description: Create bulk question upload functionality via CSV import and implement content assignment system for individuals, teams, and departments.
details: Design CSV template format for bulk question upload with validation schema. Implement file upload component with CSV parsing using a library like Papa Parse. Create validation system for CSV data including error reporting and preview functionality. Build assignment interface allowing selection of individuals, teams, or departments. Extend database schema for user groups, teams, and assignments. Implement assignment tracking with status monitoring. Create API endpoints for bulk operations with proper error handling and batch processing. Add progress indicators for large uploads and assignment operations.
test_strategy: Unit tests for CSV parsing, validation logic, and assignment algorithms. Integration tests for bulk upload process and assignment creation. E2E tests for complete CSV upload workflow and assignment functionality with various user group types.

title: Implement RBAC Protection and Navigation Integration
description: Secure the AI chat feature with role-based access control, ensuring only Managers and Executives can access the functionality, and integrate the feature into the application's navigation system.
details: Update lib/auth.ts (or equivalent authentication module) to include RBAC checks for the AI chat feature. Implement server-side protection for both the page route and API endpoint, ensuring unauthorized users receive appropriate 403 responses. Add client-side route protection to prevent unauthorized access attempts. Update the navigation component (likely in components/ui/sidebar.tsx or similar) to conditionally display the 'AI Insights' menu item based on user role. Ensure the navigation item is only visible to users with Manager or Executive roles. Implement proper redirect logic for unauthorized access attempts. Add session validation to ensure users maintain proper permissions throughout their session. Test that role changes are immediately reflected in navigation and access permissions.
test_strategy: Create comprehensive RBAC tests covering both authorized and unauthorized access scenarios. Test the API endpoint with different user roles to ensure proper access control. Verify that navigation items appear/disappear correctly based on user roles. Implement E2E tests that simulate role-based access patterns and ensure unauthorized users cannot access the feature through direct URL navigation.
